extraction.notes: Synthetic case, no real patient data. WHAT THIS TESTS: a large input in which three suppression mechanisms and two arbitration clusters interact at once, under § 6a Minderung. 21 Ziffern reach the rules engine across the chapters B, C, F, M and O; 14 survive onto the invoice and 7 are blocked, each with its own reason. EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR, mechanism by mechanism: (1) exclusion cluster Nr. 5 / Nr. 7 / Nr. 8 — the whole-body status is the best documented of the three, so Nr. 8 is charged and Nr. 5 and Nr. 7 are blocked as conflict_lost; (2) exclusion cluster Nr. 422 / Nr. 423 / Nr. 424 — the full Doppler study is documented, so Nr. 424 is charged and the two weaker records are blocked; (3) exclusion cluster Nr. 650 bis 653 — the twelve-lead resting ECG (Nr. 651) beats the monitor strip (Nr. 650), while the 24-hour recording Nr. 659 is chargeable alongside because no rule excludes it; (4) specificity — the knee puncture matches Nr. 300 and Nr. 301, and the knee-specific Nr. 301 displaces the generic position; (5) Zielleistung — the dressing Nr. 200 is a component of the puncture and is blocked by the SURVIVING parent Nr. 301, not by the suppressed Nr. 300, which is what the stratification of the rules program guarantees. The two documented justifications raise exactly two lines (Nr. 8 to the Höchstsatz 3.5, Nr. 301 to 2.6) and leave the other twelve at their Schwellenwert. Because the encounter is stationär, § 6a GOÄ reduces every line by 25 percent.
